The mic is hot and the queens are ready 🎤👑 Drag Queen Karaoke is back at Azucar and this time Beah Hazard's running the show. You pick the song, you own the stage, and between your sets our queens slide in with live drag numbers that'll have you screaming before you even get your turn. Belt it, flop it, don't care — this crowd's here for you either way. Sign up when you walk in, grab a drink, and get ready to either become a star or watch your friend become one. Free entry means zero reasons to sit this one out. La pista is calling and so is that one song you've been practicing in the shower 🎶✨

🗓️ Wednesday, November 25 • 7PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free entry

Feel that bass drop before you even walk in 🎤💚 Azucar turns electric on karaoke night — glittered queens weaving between tables, strangers turning into hype squads, somebody's belting a power ballad while the whole room loses it. Beah Hazard keeps the energy cranked all night, mic in one hand, charisma in the other. It's sweaty, it's loud, it's the kind of chaotic beautiful only Azucar can pull off. You'll laugh at the flops, scream at the showstoppers, and leave with your voice half gone and your heart completely full. This is what Wednesday nights are supposed to feel like 🎶🔥

Come however you are — this stage doesn't judge, it just hands you the mic 🫶🎤 Drag Queen Karaoke at Azucar is built for everybody: the shower singers, the theater kids, the ones who swore they'd never sing in public and end up signing up twice. Beah Hazard hosts a room that feels like home — supportive, loud, full of strangers cheering for strangers. Our community shows up for each other here, no judgment, just good energy and even better singing (or not, and that's fine too). Make a friend, make a memory, maybe make a fool of yourself in the best possible way. Free entry, open arms, every other Wednesday 💕

Mark it down — Drag Queen Karaoke hits Azucar on Wednesday, November 25th, 7PM sharp 📝🎤 Hosted by Beah Hazard, this is sign-up-and-sing karaoke with live drag performances woven in between songs. Free entry, no ticket needed, every other Wednesday all month long. Get there early if you want first pick on the song list — spots fill up fast once the regulars hear it's back. Bring your friends, your confidence (or lack of it), and get ready for a night built on good songs, good drag, and even better company 🎶✨
